title: Session 1: Power BI Fundamentals & Data Modeling

questions.questionText: Which language is used to create measures and calculated columns in Power BI?
questions.explanation: DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) is the formula expression language used in Power BI, Analysis Services, and Power Pivot in Excel to define calculations, measures, and calculated columns.

questions.questionText: Which tool is used to clean and transform data before loading it into the model?
questions.explanation: Power Query Editor is the data extraction, transformation, and cleansing tool inside Power BI Desktop used prior to loading data into the data model.

questions.questionText: What is the file extension of a Power BI Desktop report?
questions.explanation: .pbix is the standard file extension for Power BI Desktop reports containing the data model, queries, and report visualizations.

questions.questionText: Which view in Power BI Desktop is used to create and manage relationships between tables?
questions.explanation: Model view displays diagrammatic representations of tables and allows creating, configuring, and managing relationships and cardinality between tables.

questions.questionText: Which language is used by Power Query to define transformation steps?
questions.explanation: The Power Query Formula Language, informally known as 'M', is the functional, case-sensitive language behind Power Query transformation steps.

questions.questionText: Which DAX function changes the filter context of a calculation?
questions.explanation: CALCULATE evaluates an expression in a modified filter context and is the most powerful and fundamental function in DAX.

questions.questionText: What is the most common relationship cardinality in a Power BI data model?
questions.explanation: One-to-many (1:*) relationships, typically linking a dimension table (unique keys) to a fact table (repeating keys), are the most common relationship cardinality.

questions.questionText: Which DAX function returns the number of unique values in a column?
questions.explanation: DISTINCTCOUNT counts the number of distinct (unique) values in a column.

questions.questionText: Which storage mode loads a copy of the data into the Power BI in-memory model?
questions.explanation: Import mode caches and compresses a copy of the source data into the VertiPaq in-memory analytical engine for fast query performance.

questions.questionText: Which visual is best for showing a trend over time?
questions.explanation: A line chart connects continuous data points over intervals (such as time) and is optimal for identifying trends and patterns.

questions.questionText: What is the main purpose of a slicer?
questions.explanation: A slicer is an on-canvas interactive visual filter that allows report consumers to filter and slice the data shown in other visuals on the report page.

questions.questionText: Which schema design is recommended for Power BI data models?
questions.explanation: Microsoft strongly recommends a Star Schema (fact tables surrounded by related dimension tables) for optimal Power BI performance, usability, and DAX simplicity.

questions.questionText: What does Row-Level Security (RLS) do?
options: Restricts data access for users based on roles
Limits the number of rows imported
questions.correctAnswer: Restricts data access for users based on roles
questions.explanation: Row-Level Security (RLS) restricts data row access for specific users based on their defined role and DAX filter expressions.

questions.questionText: Which component is needed to refresh on-premises data sources in the Power BI Service?
questions.explanation: The On-premises data gateway acts as a bridge providing secure and quick data transfer between on-premises data sources and the cloud-based Power BI Service.

questions.questionText: What is a Power BI dashboard?
options: A single page of pinned visuals from one or more reports
questions.correctAnswer: A single page of pinned visuals from one or more reports
questions.explanation: In the Power BI Service, a dashboard is a single-page canvas (often called a canvas) made up of pinned tiles from one or multiple reports.

questions.questionText: Which visual lets users ask questions in natural language?
questions.explanation: The Q&A visual enables users to explore data using conversational, natural language questions and automatically generates appropriate charts in response.

questions.questionText: Where do teams collaborate on reports, dashboards and datasets in the Power BI Service?
questions.explanation: Workspaces are collaborative cloud environments in the Power BI Service where teams create, publish, and manage collections of dashboards, reports, and datasets.

questions.questionText: How does a measure differ from a calculated column?
options: A measure is stored per row; a column is not
A measure is calculated at query time; a column is computed at refresh and stored
A measure can only use M
questions.correctAnswer: A measure is calculated at query time; a column is computed at refresh and stored
questions.explanation: A calculated column is computed row-by-row during data refresh and stored in the model consuming RAM; a measure is evaluated dynamically at query time based on user interactions and filter context.

questions.questionText: Which DAX function retrieves a value from a related table on the 'one' side of a relationship?
questions.explanation: The RELATED function follows existing many-to-one relationships to fetch a value from the table on the 'one' side.

questions.questionText: Which feature saves a specific state of a report page, including filters and visibility?
questions.explanation: Bookmarks capture the current state of a report page—including filters, slicers, drill states, visual visibility, and sort order—enabling custom navigation and storytelling.
